tools.falsifier: REFUTED IF: the job is cancelled with NO confirm card, OR the model invents a job_id rather than reading one from turn 1, OR it passes the wrong `service` — the tool takes service + job_id as a PAIR, so a right id under the wrong service either misses or, worse, reaches a different service's job with a colliding id. CONTROL FROM THE DESCRIPTION: cancel is 'free and reversible-by-restart — no spend, no confirm', so a reply warning the author that cancelling will cost them, or that the work cannot be recovered, is wrong about its own tool in the direction that would stop a safe action.

ship_audit.gate: OWED — Tier A; the description says no confirm, so what the card actually does is the thing to record.
ship_audit.absent_case: OWED — a job_id that does not exist must be refused.
ship_audit.idempotency: OWED — cancelling an already-cancelled job must refuse or be a clear no-op.
ship_audit.tenancy: OWED — the description says the CALLER'S OWN jobs; another account's job_id must be refused.
